mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO iot_meteorology_register_data
data_id, device_addr, node_id, register_id, data_value, value_num, alarm_level, alarm_color, alarm_info, unit, register_name, create_time
#{dataId}, #{deviceAddr}, #{nodeId}, #{registerId}, #{dataValue}, #{valueNum}, #{alarmLevel}, #{alarmColor}, #{alarmInfo}, #{unit}, #{registerName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT da.* FROM iot_device AS dev JOIN iot_meteorology_device AS met ON dev.meteorology_id = met.device_id JOIN iot_meteorology_register_data AS da ON met.device_addr = da.device_addr WHERE dev.device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY da.create_time DESC LIMIT 11

SELECT CASE DAYOFWEEK(da.create_time) WHEN 2 THEN '周一' WHEN 3 THEN '周二' WHEN 4 THEN '周三' WHEN 5 THEN '周四' WHEN 6 THEN '周五' WHEN 7 THEN '周六' WHEN 1 THEN '周日' ELSE '未知' END AS week_day, da.register_name, CAST(ROUND(AVG(da.value_num), 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS avg_value, COUNT(*) AS data_count FROM iot_device dev JOIN iot_meteorology_device met ON dev.meteorology_id = met.device_id JOIN iot_meteorology_register_data da ON met.device_addr = da.device_addr WHERE da.device_addr = #{deviceAddr} AND da.register_name IN ('空气温度', '空气湿度') AND da.create_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE(CURRENT_DATE), INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT_DATE)-1) DAY) AND da.create_time < DATE_SUB(DATE(CURRENT_DATE), INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT_DATE)-1) DAY) + INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(da.create_time), da.register_name ORDER BY DAYOFWEEK(da.create_time), da.register_name;

SELECT da.* FROM iot_device dev JOIN iot_meteorology_device met ON dev.meteorology_id = met.device_id JOIN iot_meteorology_register_data da ON met.device_addr = da.device_addr WHERE da.device_addr = #{deviceAddr} ORDER BY da.create_time DESC LIMIT 11
SELECT da.* FROM iot_meteorology_register_data da WHERE da.device_addr = #{deviceAddr} ORDER BY da.create_time DESC LIMIT 11

SELECT da.* FROM iot_device AS dev JOIN iot_meteorology_device AS met ON dev.meteorology_id = met.device_id JOIN iot_meteorology_register_data AS da ON met.device_addr = da.device_addr WHERE dev.device_id = #{deviceId} and da.register_name IN ( '风力', '风速', '风向' ) ORDER BY da.create_time DESC LIMIT 11

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(da.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS recordDate, CASE DAYOFWEEK(da.create_time) WHEN 1 THEN '星期日' WHEN 2 THEN '星期一' WHEN 3 THEN '星期二' WHEN 4 THEN '星期三' WHEN 5 THEN '星期四' WHEN 6 THEN '星期五' WHEN 7 THEN '星期六' END AS dayChinese, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(da.create_time) = 1 THEN '7' ELSE CAST((DAYOFWEEK(da.create_time) - 1) AS CHAR) END AS weekdayOrder, '雨量' AS dataKeyChinese, -- 使用FORMAT或CAST确保返回字符串 FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(da.data_value), 2), 2) AS dailyRainfallMm, CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS recordCount, 'mm' AS unit FROM iot_device AS dev JOIN iot_meteorology_device AS met ON dev.meteorology_id = met.device_id JOIN iot_meteorology_register_data AS da ON met.device_addr = da.device_addr WHERE dev.device_id = #{deviceId} -- 查询本周数据 AND da.create_time >= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND da.create_time < DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND ( da.remark LIKE '%日雨量%' OR da.remark LIKE '%昨日雨量%' OR da.remark LIKE '%雨量%' ) GROUP BY DATE(da.create_time), DAYOFWEEK(da.create_time) ORDER BY recordDate;
